source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Look up the previous inspection report, or generate the necessary report.
3. Take notes on the safety or procedural issues that the inspection found.
4. Properly cite health and safety regulations so that the report is in compliance.
5. Share the report with any professionals who worked with you on the inspection.
6. Submit the report to the department head or safety team as required.

Industrial safety auditing is necessary in almost every workplace.

There is a large focus on workplace safety in all industries because there are always risks of accidents and hazards, and these risks are only increased when dealing with heavy machinery, chemicals, and other tools used in industrial facilities.

Businesses are required to submit documents like the safety data log or safety observation report to ensure that their place of business is operating in compliance with health and safety regulations.

The last thing any business wants is to be found out of compliance when it should have been taking proper safety precautions.
